title: Patch: callout icons for the ten defensive keywords
notes: The ten defensive keywords (Divine Shield, Armor, Indestructible, Immutable, Reborn, Brittle, Immune to Spells, Taunt, Can't Defend, Can't attack) each get a callout icon for their effect beat. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Callout icons for the defensive keywords
changes: Divine Shield, Armor, Indestructible, Immutable, Reborn, Brittle, Immune to Spells, Taunt, Can't Defend and Can't attack each show their own icon beside their effect callout.
